overview_description.description: Derayah Financial is a digital investment firm and brokerage that provides online access to local and global stock, ETF, bond, margin trading, and derivatives markets, as well as Shariah-compliant advisory and robo-advisory services. The firm offers mutual funds, real estate investments, discretionary portfolio management, and research tools.

about_short_description.short_description: Derayah Financial was established to protect and empower individual investors to take control of their financial success.

product.name: Derayah Trading Platform
product.description: A platform offering instant trading and investment tracking with a single account, providing financial brokerage services and margin financing products.

product.name: Derayah Global Platform
product.description: Allows users to track real-time prices and execute orders across 17 global exchanges, with features like watchlists and multiple order types.

product.name: Derayah Smart
product.description: An investment service offering diversified, Sharia-compliant portfolios managed by investment advisors, with low fees and electronic operations.

product.name: Derayah REIT
product.description: A closed-end real estate investment fund distributing quarterly profits, focusing on income-generating real estate opportunities.

product.name: Derayah Flexible Saudi Equity Fund
product.description: Invests in Saudi-listed companies for long-term capital growth, adhering to Sharia standards, with reinvested profits.
